blocks.task_summary: Sketch the graph of y = arccos x for -1 ≤ x ≤ 1, indicating the y-intercept and coordinates of the end points.
method_path: Sketch the curve of y = arccos x with correct shape within domain [-1, 1]

evidence.basis: For a curve with correct shape within the domain, correct labelled y-intercept and end points. A2. Note: Award A1 for any two of the following provided a curve is seen: correct shape within the domain, correctly labelled y-intercept, correctly labelled end points.

blocks.task_summary: Solve arccos x + arccos(3x) = 3π/2 for x.
method_path: Apply compound angle formula for cos(A+B) or sin(A+B)
Express sin(arccos x) and sin(arccos(3x)) using √(1 - x²) and √(1 - 9x²)
Substitute known value cos(3π/2)=0 or sin(3π/2)=-1
Reject x = 1/2 using graph from part (a) or domain check, leaving x = -1/2
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 1: Use cos(A+B) formula, leading to x = -1/2.
METHOD 2: Use sin(A+B) formula, leading to x = -1/2.

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: recognizing to use compound angle rule for cos(A+B) (M1); valid attempt to find sin(arccos x) or sin(arccos 3x) in terms of x (M1); use of the identity sin²θ = 1 - cos²θ OR use of a right-angled triangle ... A1; cos(3π/2)=0 (seen anywhere) (A1); attempt to write an equation in x without the square roots (M1); x = ±1/2 ... x = -1/2 A1.

METHOD 2: recognizing to use compound angle rule for sin(A+B) (M1); valid attempt to find sin(arccos x) or sin(arccos 3x) in terms of x (M1); use of the identity sin²θ = 1 - cos²θ OR use of a right-angled triangle ... A1; sin(3π/2)=-1 (seen anywhere) (A1); attempt to write an equation in x without the square roots (M1); x = ±1/2 ... x = -1/2 A1.
